description_en: Deletes user tag-resource relationships to remove user tags from resources
description_zh: 删除用户标签资源关系，即可为资源删除用户标签
kebab_example: aliyun oos untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids key=example-string --resource-type template --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource IDs of cloud resources for which you want to modify the resource group. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs.

If ResourceType is set to template, set ResourceIds to ["TemplateName1","TemplateName2"].

If ResourceType is set to parameter, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"].

If ResourceType is set to secretparameter, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"].
If ResourceType is set to stateconfiguration, set ResourceIds to ["StateConfigurationId1","StateConfigurationId2"].
If ResourceType is set to application, set ResourceIds to ["Name1","Name2"]
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group. Valid values:

template: template.
parameter: parameter.
secretparameter: encrypted parameter.
stateconfiguration: desired state configuration.
application: application
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：

template: 模板。
parameter: 参数。
secretparameter: 加密参数。
stateconfiguration: 终态配置。
application: 应用
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 标签键列表，键的数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tag_keys

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter takes effect only when TagKeys is empty. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false, TagKeys is required
parameters.help_zh: 是否全部删除，仅当TagKeys为空时有效。取值范围：true或false，默认是false。当该参数为false时，TagKeys则是必选参数
parameters.name: all
